result.summary:
I found no correctness defects in this change.

**Breaking-change marker:** the PR title needs one, e.g. `fix(proxy)!:`. Before this PR, a request to `/utils/token_counter?call_endpoint=true` that sent both `prompt` and a non-empty `messages` or `contents` got a 200 counting only the conversation. Now it gets a 400 unless `drop_params` is set. The PR description explains the impact and the migration (set `drop_params`), so the title marker is the only missing piece.

checks.name: Real testing evidence
checks.details: Not applicable: no LLM translation changes in the scoped paths. The diff changes only `litellm/proxy/proxy_server.py` and two test files under `tests/unit/proxy/`. It touches nothing under `litellm/llms/**` or `litellm/litellm_core_utils/prompt_templates/**`.

checks.name: Changed unit tests
checks.details: I ran `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/unit/proxy/test_proxy_token_counter.py tests/unit/proxy/proxy_server/test_routes_utils.py` on the head checkout: 58 passed.

checks.name: Caller trace
checks.details: Besides `/utils/token_counter`, two internal callers build a `TokenCountRequest`: `anthropic_endpoints/endpoints.py:350` and `google_endpoints/endpoints.py:88`. Neither sets `prompt`, so the new 400 guard and the prompt-to-message conversion cannot fire for them.
